properties.answer: Anthony, 2026-07-28: accept component granularity here. The cmp:skills bundle check is a real passing verification one hop away, and these five are skill documents whose behaviour is largely the text itself.
properties.context_setter: 5 capability(ies) verified only at component granularity via “skills”
properties.question: One test covers the whole skills bundle, and that test passes — but five specific things it contains (brainstorm, changing an existing feature, delta-reconcile, onboarding, and parallel work) have no test of their own. Is the one bundle-level test good enough for these five, or should any of them be proven on its own?
